threshold_note: Not part of the sklearn model object — predict_proba has no concept of it. Anything loading this model must read this threshold from here rather than hardcoding 0.5 or any other value separately.
training_data: train split only (60% of data-gen/sensor/ai4i2020.csv, stratified on Machine failure) — not train+val combined
split_method: Two-stage stratified train_test_split via ml_detector.split_dataset: 60/20/20 train/val/test, stratified on Machine failure at each stage, random_state=42
